strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 8

Price Range: 1-2 points

Overview: Honchkrow is a hard-hitting offensive tool with a solid Attack stat that enables it to fire off powerful STAB moves. Its Moxie ability and strong priority Sucker Punch allow it to snowball as a physical threat, while having a respectable Special Attack stat enables it to run special or mixed sets. However, Honchkrow is held back by its bad typing, poor Speed and defenses, and propensity to take damage from various sources, such as Stealth Rock and Brave Bird recoil, limiting the amount of damage it can do before fainting. Moreover, its Dark-type physical movepool is lackluster, as it does not get Knock Off, and its reliance on the inconsistent Sucker Punch, holds it back immensely.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Wallbreaker: By using Damage-boosting items, Honchkrow can bombard opposing Pokemon with its STAB moves, such as Brave Bird and Night Slash. It can also run mixed sets to counter physically defensive Pokemon that may switch in, catching them off guard.

Pivot: Honchkrow can also use Heavy-Duty Boots to circumvent its weakness to Stealth Rock and generate momentum for its team with U-turn, as many slower Pokemon have to switch out in fear of its Brave Bird, and faster Pokemon are threatened by its Sucker Punch. This set can slot in Taunt or Thunder Wave to cause further disruption to the enemy team, preventing it from setting up entry hazards or spreading status.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Brave Bird, Sucker Punch, Night Slash, Dark Pulse, Hurricane

Setup Moves: Calm Mind, Nasty Plot

Utility Moves: U-turn, Taunt, Haze, Thunder Wave, Whirlwind

Coverage: Heat Wave, Psychic, Psychic Noise, Hex

Niche Moves

Perish Song: When an opposing Pokemon intends to set up on Honchkrow or when Honchkrow struggles to KO a bulky Pokemon, Perish Song can be used to force a switch out.

Foul Play: Honchkrow can use STAB Foul Play to damage Pokemon with high Attack or those intending to set up.

Common Items

Damage-boosting Items: Damage-boosting items such as Life Orb, Sharp Beak and Black Glasses power up Honchkrow’s attacks while allowing it to switch moves when necessary.

Choice Band: Choice Band gives Honchkrow's Brave Bird immediate power. It also makes revenge killing with Honchkrow's Sucker Punch much easier.

Heavy-Duty Boots: Heavy-Duty Boots allows Honchkrow to come in throughout a match without worrying about its Stealth Rock weakness.

Niche Items

Choice Scarf: Honchkrow can don a Choice scarf to get the drop on foes with its increased Speed and try to sweep with Moxie, but it will still get outsped by other Pokemon that commonly use Speed-boosting items.

Scope Lens: On wallbreaking sets, the increased critical hit ratio from Scope Lens gives Honchkrow a chance to deal massive damage with Night Slash and Super Luck.

Assault Vest: Honchkrow can equip Assault Vest to patch up its weaker Special Defense to check Special attackers while still being able to grab momentum with U-turn.

Tera

Honchkrow is generally outclassed by other Pokemon at its cost level as a secondary Tera Captain, as it is still held back by its Speed and low bulk. However, when selected as one, Honchkrow can use Tera Flying or Tera Dark to increase the power of its STAB attacks to nuclear levels.

Draft Strategy

Honchkrow stands out among the lower tiers as a powerful attacker with quite a few abilities at its disposal, such as wallbreaking and pivoting. Drafts with already strong pivoting and entry hazard removal can appericate Honchkrow being another offensive Pokemon on the team.

Checks and Counters

Flying- and Dark-resistant Pokemon: Pokemon that resist Honchkrow's STAB moves, such as Raging Bolt, Tinkaton, and Tyranitar, can come in on Honchkrow's attacks easily and threaten it out.

Faster Pokemon: Pokemon that outrun Honchkrow can easily OHKO it with a super effective move, such as Meowscarada, Iron Valiant, and Enamorus.

Physical Walls: Pokemon like Dondozo, Zapdos, and Garganacl often have enough bulk and recovery to outlast Honchkrow as it faints to recoil or chip damage.
